_readme: Automated event sources. A source is fetched ONLY when enabled is true AND permission.status is "approved" with a basis and verifiedOn date. See README.md > 'Adding an approved source'. Supported types: ics, jsonld, json, ticketmaster.

permission.basis: Official Discovery API under the Ticketmaster developer terms. Requires a free API key in the TICKETMASTER_API_KEY secret and Ticketmaster attribution/links on each listing (the site shows 'via Ticketmaster' and links to the official page).

sources.name: Example: City parks & recreation calendar (replace me)

permission.basis: Describe why you're allowed to republish, e.g. 'City publishes a public iCal subscribe link; site terms permit reuse with attribution' or 'Email from events@city on 2026-10-01 granting permission'.

sources.name: Example: Venue events page with schema.org data (replace me)

permission.basis: Only for venues/organizers that agreed to be listed (or whose terms allow it). The updater also obeys robots.txt for this type.

sources.name: Example: Open-data JSON events API (replace me)

permission.basis: Link to the API terms that permit display on third-party sites.
